html.body: Date: 2025-05-01 Apple. No. 18/081,984 Amdt. Dated May 1, 2025 Response to Notice of Allowance REMARKS/ARGUMENTS1. This amendment is being submitted on or before payment of the issue fee to correct potential antecedent basis issues. Applicant respectfully submits that the amendments add no new matter, should not require any further examination, and should not place an undue burden on the Office.2. Recognizing that Internet communications are not secure, I hereby authorize the USPTO to communicate with the undersigned and practitioners in accordance with 37 CFR 1.33 and 37 CFR 1.34 concerning any subject matter of this application by video conferencing, instant messaging, or electronic mail. I understand that a copy of these communications will be made of record in the application file.3. Applicant believes that no extension fee is required for consideration of this amendment.In the event that a fee is required, Applicant requests that Deposit Account Number 14-1449 be charged.Date: Mai 1, 2025 Respectfully submitted, /Emmanuel D. Filandrianos, #74,306/ Emmanuel D.
